name: unproven-when-the-signal-says-no
why: A target carrying the release whose declared acceptance answers NO is unproven, which is the loudest state on the line: something claims to serve the proven release and its own signal disagrees. It outranks every other kind of attention, so it heads the queue even where a door has been open longer. The detail names what was read, because 'unproven' alone does not tell the operator which signal refused.

positions.name: serving-badly
positions.detail: serves v2.1.0, and its declared suite does not answer
